topic: Maui and Hawaii dental-lab market: verify/refute "Maui lacks dental labs"; dentist counts; current lab supply chain; Maui-specific tax, registration, licensing, wage, rent and travel economics; obtainable demand for a Bellevue lab
summary:
VERDICT ON THE CLAIM. "Maui lacks dental labs" is half-true and should be restated precisely: Maui has no independent commercial crown-and-bridge or implant laboratory that we could find, but it is not lab-free. Two tiny independent removable labs exist on paper: Pacific Rim Dental Laboratory (199 N Church St, Wailuku; David Eirinberg; dentures/partials/repairs only; opened 1978; live website, undated) and Elua II Dental Laboratory (1993 S Kihei Rd #214, Kihei; Clayton Mizufuka; SIC denture production; one 5.0 Google review; no website; 2025-26 activity unverified). A third directory listing, Precision Dental Technik LLC (33 Lono Ave #370, Kahului, Marco Kruger, "4 employees"), is almost certainly a ghost: the owner's LinkedIn dates his ownership Jan 2002 to Jan 2012 and lists him as a MicroDental consultant now, and Suite 370 at 33 Lono Ave is today Kahului Dental (a dentist office). More important for Integra: at least four Maui practices run captive digital labs (Maui Prosthodontics, Dr. Erik K. Wong, 5-axis mill, 3D printing, CEREC, in-house Ivotion dentures; Kai Dental, Kihei, Drs. Hollander and Roberts, on-site lab with full-time technician and 5-axis mill; Lahaina Smiles Dental, reopened at Lahaina Gateway with a "3D printing lab" and "crown milling center"; Island Smiles Dental, Kahului, markets an in-house lab), and at least seven practices advertise CEREC/same-day crowns (Kai Dental, Miyamoto Dental Design Suite, Dental Care of Maui, Smile Hawaii/Dr. Lance Ogata, Lahaina Smiles, Maui Prosthodontics, Smiles with Aloha per Healthgrades). With roughly 64 payroll dental offices on Maui (Census CBP 2023 via Groundwork) that is on the order of 10% of practices milling their own single units. Oahu, by contrast, has a dozen-plus independent labs (Honolulu Dental Laboratory, which says it has served "Oahu and the Neighbor Islands" for 60 years; Esthetic Dental Designs; Intuitive Dental Creations, full-arch; Premier; Kamaaina Prosthetic; Downtown Dental Lab; others), the Big Island has Kona Coast Dental Lab (est. 1977, accepts digital files, Seattle Study Club member) plus several small labs, and Kauai has two small labs.

DENTIST COUNT (FACT). DCCA PVL licensing data as of Sept 30, 2024 (DBEDT Data Book Table 2.36) shows 116 dentists with a Maui-island address plus 3 Molokai and 1 Lanai (120 in Maui County), out of 1,140 in-state and 1,436 total Hawaii licensees (291 on the mainland). HIPHI's 2025 needs assessment counts 106 Maui dental providers in 2023 and a population-to-dentist ratio of 1,551:1 (statewide 1,320:1). Map listings show 76 dentist/orthodontist locations (Sept 2026). HRSA designates seven dental HPSAs in Maui County, but these are Medicaid/geographic access designations (Hana, Molokai, Lanai, community clinics), not evidence of unmet private restorative demand.

HOW MAUI GETS LAB WORK TODAY (FACT/ESTIMATE). No Maui dentist page names its outside lab. The supply chain is inferable: Glidewell offers prepaid USPS Priority Mail labels at no cost (its $9 FedEx option is "contiguous U.S. only"), 3-day in-lab digital turnaround, and USPS's new Oct 1, 2026 standard is 2-4 days each way to Hawaii; Next Dental Lab (FL) explicitly markets Kahului with "about 5 business days of ground transit each way" and claims typical Hawaii lab fees of $105-200 for a zirconia crown (self-serving, unverified); Keating and PRO-Craft market Hawaii with 3-5 day delivery claims; Dandy is 100% digital with no Hawaii-specific statement found. Honolulu Dental Lab is the only Oahu lab that explicitly claims neighbor-island service; the shipping method is not described.

MAUI ECONOMICS (FACT). Maui County adopted the 0.5% GET surcharge effective Jan 1, 2024 through Dec 31, 2030, so the retail GET rate on Maui is 4.5% (max pass-on 4.712%). Crucially, lab sales to dentists are NOT at that rate: HRS 237-24.3(6) excludes dental devices from the prosthetic-device exemption, but HRS 237-15 taxes technicians who supply dentists with prostheses "as though the technician were a manufacturer selling a product to a licensed retailer," i.e., the 0.5% wholesale rate, and the county surcharge does not apply to 0.5% activity (confirmed in the 2024 Form G-45 instructions). If Integra stays unregistered, the Maui dentist owes 0.5% use tax on landed value under HRS 238-2(2)(D). Act 41 (2018) economic nexus requires GET registration at $100,000 of Hawaii-delivered sales OR 200 transactions in the current or prior calendar year; for a lab, 200 cases/year (about 17/month) is the binding trigger. Foreign LLC registration is $50 (+$25 expedite, +$1 archives) with a $15 annual report; it is only needed if Integra physically transacts business in Hawaii. Hawaii does not license dental labs or technicians: HRS 448-3(a) expressly permits "any unlicensed person" to perform "mechanical work upon inert matter in a dental laboratory." BLS OEWS May 2025: Hawaii dental lab technicians, 120 employed, median $45,300, mean $47,560; no estimate is published for the Kahului-Wailuku MSA. Small Maui office space lists at $1.35-$1.65/SF/mo NNN (691 SF sublease, Kihei) to $2.50-$4.00/SF/mo NNN (Kahului/Wailuku), plus CAM ($0.48-$0.94/SF) and GET passed through at 4.712%. Travel: SEA-OGG nonstop daily (Alaska 26/wk, Delta 7/wk); HVCB quarterly average round-trip base fare from Seattle $602-$697 (Q2 2025-Q1 2026); Google Flights typical $365-780; midsize rental car about $82/day shoulder season ($312/wk Aug 2026, $635/wk June 2026); Maui hotel ADR $526 and vacation-rental ADR $649 in Aug 2026, with Wailea/Kihei rentals about $438-$453.

OBTAINABLE DEMAND (ESTIMATE). Maui is a small, well-served island: ~64 practices, ~10% self-milling, nationally marketed labs with free USPS inbound and 3-5 day in-lab times, an Oahu lab tier, and $129 Integra zirconia priced above Glidewell-tier and far above Next's $39. Integra has no Hawaii-specific advantage except relationships (the Sept-Oct 2026 trip, Seattle Study Club ties via the Maui Professional Dental Forum chapter) and Alaska Air Cargo potential that is not yet operational. A defensible base case is 2-4 Maui practices sending recurring work within 12 months, 15-40 units/month, with upside of 6-8 practices and 50-80 units/month only if Integra works the island in person. The highest-value Maui angles are not single crowns: full-arch cases generated by Maui Jaw Surgical Institute and Maui Oral Surgery (both "same-day teeth"/All-on-4 centers whose GPs need finals), ti-bar/superstructure work for Kai Dental and Miyamoto, and ARUM/MillBox sales and service to the practices already milling in-house (Lahaina Smiles, Kai, Maui Prosthodontics, Island Smiles), where Maui has zero local service capability. Switch triggers that matter: digital-only Rx with no inbound shipping, a published Hawaii delivery commitment (e.g., scan-to-door 6 business days), transparent pricing at or below mainland tiers, full-arch/ti-bar depth, and periodic on-island visits. Nothing found supports calling Maui "underserved" for restorative lab work.

findings.claim: Maui has no independent commercial crown-and-bridge/implant lab found; it has two tiny independent denture labs and several captive in-office digital labs
findings.detail: Exhaustive search of Google/Exa Places, Yelp-style directories, SIC 8072 directories and company sites surfaced only Pacific Rim Dental Laboratory (dentures/partials, Wailuku) and Elua II Dental Laboratory (denture production, Kihei) as independent labs physically on Maui. Captive labs: Maui Prosthodontics (5-axis mill, 3D printing, CEREC, Ivotion), Kai Dental (on-site lab, full-time technician, 5-axis mill), Lahaina Smiles (3D printing lab, crown milling center), Island Smiles Dental (in-house lab). DCCA business registry and FDA establishment database were not queryable with available tools.
findings.value: 0 independent C&B labs; 2 independent removable labs; 4+ captive labs

findings.claim: Pacific Rim Dental Laboratory, Wailuku, is a one-technician denture/partial lab, not a crown-and-bridge lab
findings.detail: Site: 'located in Wailuku, Maui... creating dentures, dental plates, denture repairs, partials and repairs'; lab opened 1978 per site history page; 199 N Church St, (808) 244-4785; owner/technician David Eirinberg; directory estimates 1 employee. No crown/bridge/implant services listed.

findings.claim: Elua II Dental Laboratory, Kihei, exists in directories as a denture-production lab; current activity unverified
findings.detail: 1993 S Kihei Rd #214, Kihei 96753; (808) 879-6990; owner Clayton Mizufuka; SIC 8072 'Denture Production'; one 5.0 Google rating; no website found; no dated 2025-2026 activity found.

findings.claim: Precision Dental Technik LLC (Kahului) appears defunct; directory listings are stale
findings.detail: Directories list 33 Lono Ave #370, owner Marco Kruger, 4 employees, est. 2002. Kruger's LinkedIn shows 'Owner - Precision Dental Technik, Jan 2002 - Jan 2012' and current role 'Dental Tech Consultant - MicroDental Laboratory'. 33 Lono Ave Suite 370 is now Kahului Dental (Dr. Trace Baxter).

findings.claim: Maui Prosthodontics claims to be the only dental office and laboratory in Hawaii fabricating Ivotion digital dentures fully in-house, with 5-axis milling and CEREC
findings.detail: Services page: 'Our fully integrated digital workflow includes 3D printing, 5-axis milling, CEREC same-day restorations, and the Ivotion digital denture system... the only dental office and laboratory in the state with the capability to fabricate Ivotion digital dentures entirely in-house.' Dr. Erik K. Wong DMD, 140 Hoohana St Ste 300, Kahului; practice since 1984.

findings.claim: Kai Dental (Kihei) operates an on-site lab with a full-time technician and a 5-axis mill and does All-on-4 with zirconia finals
findings.detail: Technology page: 'Our onsite dental laboratory, staffed by a full-time lab technician, allows us to fabricate restorations in-house... 5-Axis Mill... in-house 3D printing.' All-on-4 page: 'permanent zirconia bridge'. Drs. Jesse Hollander and Roberts, 1325 S Kihei Rd Ste 201.

findings.claim: At least seven Maui practices advertise CEREC or same-day in-office crowns, roughly 10% of Maui practices
findings.detail: Kai Dental (Kihei), Miyamoto Dental Design Suite (Wailuku, 'CEREC Crowns-In-A-Day'), Dental Care of Maui (415 Ala Makani St, Kahului, CEREC), Smile Hawaii/Dr. Lance Ogata (Kahului, CEREC, blog dated 2025-06-18), Lahaina Smiles Dental (same-day crowns, crown milling center), Maui Prosthodontics (CEREC), Smiles with Aloha (CEREC listed on Healthgrades). Denominator: 64 payroll dental offices (2023) / 76 map listings (Sept 2026).

findings.claim: Oahu has a dozen-plus independent dental labs; Honolulu Dental Laboratory explicitly claims neighbor-island service
findings.detail: Honolulu Dental Laboratory, 848 S Beretania St Ste 405: 'full service laboratory with a new emphasis on CAD CAM dentistry. Serving Oahu and the Neighbor Islands for the past 60 years' (BruxZir, dentures). Others found: Esthetic Dental Designs (725 Kapiolani Blvd C-205, est. 2009, zirconia/implant/full-arch, page dated 2025-01-22), Intuitive Dental Creations (1010 S King St B-1, full-arch, Darron Chidrawi), Premier Dental Lab (1010 S King St B-1, 30+ yrs), Kamaaina Prosthetic Dental Lab (1405 N King St Ste 304), Downtown Dental Lab (1136 Union Mall Ste 501), Oahu Dental Arts (725 Kapiolani Blvd C-201), Kikutake Robbins (1666 Kalauokalani Way #201), Island Dental Laboratory (1150 S King St #301), Alii Dental Laboratory (1520 Liliha St Ste 405), Delta Dental Laboratories (1300 Pali Hwy #212), Dentech International (1010 S King St #206), Excel Dental Lab (1132 Koko Head Ave Ste B), Roger's Dental Laboratory (2074 Young St #C), Aloha Dental Lab (Aiea, on DDX), Pacific Coast Dental Labs (Makakilo), ASO International Hawaii (ortho lab, 1441 Kapiolani Blvd, '450+ Hawaii dental practices since 2005'). Inter-island shipping method not described by any.

findings.claim: Big Island and Kauai each have small independent labs
findings.detail: Big Island: Kona Coast Dental Laboratory (81-937 Halekii St #5, Kealakekua; est. 1977; George Maragos; 'both impressions and digital files'; member Seattle Study Club and founder of Hawaii Interactive Peer Practicum; ships nationwide), Neal's Dental Laboratory (1663 Mona Loop, Hilo), Bio Ceramics Dental Laboratory (74-5626 Alapa St #A7, Kona), M D Dental Laboratory (75-5699 Alii Dr #3, Kona, Richard Davis, 1 employee est.), Akamai Dental Studio (Kona), Hoota Dental Laboratory (Hilo), Uyeda Dental Laboratory. Kauai: Kauai Dental Laboratory (3751 Hanapepe Rd, Hanapepe), Richard's Denture Lab (Lihue).

findings.claim: 116 dentists hold Maui-island addresses (120 in Maui County) out of 1,140 in-state Hawaii licensees
findings.detail: DCCA PVL 'Geographic Report (Current Licenses) as of September 30, 2024' via DBEDT Data Book Table 2.36: Dentists total 1,436; in-state 1,140; Oahu 855; Hawaii 115; Maui 116; Kauai 50; Molokai 3; Lanai 1; mainland U.S. 291; foreign 5. Permanent active licenses only.

findings.claim: HIPHI counts 106 Maui dental providers in 2023 and a 1,551:1 population-to-dentist ratio; only 29.2% accept Medicaid
findings.detail: 2025 Community Oral Health Needs Assessment & Environmental Scan (presented Sept 6, 2025): 'Total Distribution of Dental Providers in Hawai'i by County, 2023': Hawaii 110, Honolulu 832, Kauai 43, Maui 106. Population to dentist ratio: Maui 1,551:1 vs statewide 1,320:1. Providers accepting Medicaid, Maui: 29.2%.

findings.claim: Maui County has ~64 dental offices with payroll (2023) and 76 dentist/orthodontist map listings (Sept 2026)
findings.detail: Groundwork Demographics: 'official counts showed 64 businesses with payroll in Maui County classed as offices of dentists, down 3.0% from 2019'; '76 dentists and orthodontists on map listings as of September 2026', 7% chain locations; Maui County population change 2020-2025 -2.5%.

findings.claim: Hawaii Dental Association has 997 members in four county societies including the Maui County Dental Society; MCDS has no website found
findings.detail: HDA About page: '997 members representing over 92% of all dentists practicing in Hawaii'; components: Hawaii County, Honolulu County, Kauai County and Maui County Dental Societies. MCDS polled its members on CE rules per Board of Dentistry March 2025 packet. Past president: Dr. Sonia Gupta (2014). Lahaina Smiles cites the 'Maui Professional Dental Forum (Seattle Study Club)' as a Maui study club.

findings.claim: Glidewell's $9 FedEx option is contiguous-U.S. only; Hawaii dentists use free prepaid USPS Priority Mail labels, 2-4 business days each way
findings.detail: Pickup & Delivery page (dated 2026-05-05): 'FedEx Overnight for $9 each way ($18 round trip per box, contiguous U.S. only). Or use prepaid USPS Priority Mail labels at no cost. Shipping to and from the lab typically takes 2-4 business days each way.' Hawaii is selectable on the USPS label/supplies order form. Digital cases: 'three-day turnarounds for digitally prescribed all-ceramic restorations.'

findings.claim: USPS lengthened Hawaii service expectations effective Oct 1, 2026: Priority Mail 2-4 days, Ground Advantage 10+ days
findings.detail: Supply Chain Dive (Oct 5, 2026) citing USPS Sept 25 notice: Priority Mail to/from Hawaii now 2-4 days (was 2-3); Ground Advantage '10-days-plus service expectation' for Hawaii; Priority Mail Express unchanged. Relevant to any lab relying on USPS for Maui.

findings.claim: Next Dental Lab (Florida) explicitly markets Kahului/Maui with ~5 business days ground transit each way and claims Hawaii lab fees of $105-200 for a zirconia crown
findings.detail: 'Cases move by ground between our Deerfield Beach, Florida facility and Hawaii in about 5 business days each way. Prepaid shipping labels are included.' Price table: Zirconia crown $39 vs 'Typical HI lab fee $105-$200'; E.max $47 vs $125-225; All-on-X with Ti bar from $1,795 vs $2,875-4,750. Market sizing claim: 'roughly 700 practices statewide'. The 'typical HI fee' figures are the vendor's own, unsourced.

findings.claim: Keating (Irvine CA) and PRO-Craft market Hawaii; PRO-Craft claims 3-5 business day delivery and a free iTero program
findings.detail: Keating: 'Dental Laboratory Serving Hawaii Dentists... regularly outperforms local dental labs in both turnaround time and quality' (undated). PRO-Craft Kailua HI page: 'most practices receiving restorations within 3-5 business days'; 'Free Intraoral Scanner Program: Qualifying dental practices can receive a free iTero'.

findings.claim: Dandy is 100% digital (Lehi UT, Carrollton TX labs); no Hawaii-specific shipping or turnaround statement found; NDX Hawaii policy not found
findings.detail: Dandy: 'Get free, fast shipping from our 2 US based flagship labs'; 'Dandy does not accept physical impressions'; partials page: 'See if your practice is eligible for accelerated delivery times in your area... Check if your practice is in our delivery area and eligible for guaranteed turnaround' (dated 2026-03-19), implying guaranteed turnaround is geographically limited. No NDX/National Dentex Hawaii page surfaced.

findings.claim: Maui County adopted the 0.5% GET county surcharge effective Jan 1, 2024 through Dec 31, 2030; Maui retail GET is 4.5%, maximum pass-on 4.712%
findings.detail: Hawaii DOTAX: 'County of Maui: The county surcharge at the rate of 0.5% is effective from January 1, 2024 to December 31, 2030... County of Maui: 4.7120% (effective January 1, 2024 - December 31, 2030)'. 'The county surcharge does not apply to activities taxed at the 0.5% rate (e.g., wholesaling)'. Page last updated January 9, 2024.

findings.claim: Dental prosthetics are NOT exempt from GET: HRS 237-24.3(6)'s prosthetic-device exemption expressly excludes dental devices
findings.detail: Statute: '"Prosthetic device" means any artificial device... prescribed by a licensed practitioner of medicine, osteopathy, or podiatry... provided that "prosthetic device" shall not mean any auditory, ophthalmic, dental, or ocular device or appliance'.

findings.claim: Lab sales of prostheses to dentists are taxed at the 0.5% wholesale GET rate under HRS 237-15, not 4.5%, and the county surcharge does not apply
findings.detail: HRS 237-15: 'When technicians supply dentists or physicians with dentures, orthodontic devices, braces, and similar items... the technician shall be taxed as though the technician were a manufacturer selling a product to a licensed retailer, rather than at the rate of four per cent'. 2024 Form G-45 instructions: 'Technicians who supply dentists or physicians with dentures, orthodontic devices, braces, and similar items... report their gross sales from this activity on Wholesaling'. Tax Facts 37-1 (May 2025) confirms wholesaling is 0.5% and county surcharge applies only to 4% activity.

findings.claim: If the mainland lab is unregistered, the Hawaii dentist owes 0.5% use tax on the landed value of imported lab work
findings.detail: HRS 238-2(2)(D): a person in a service business 'in which the import or purchase of tangible personal property would have qualified as a sale at wholesale as defined in section 237-4(a)(8) had the seller... been subject to the tax' pays 'one-half of one per cent of the... value of such property'. Case law: freight charges included in value (56 H. 621). Dentists themselves pay 4.5% GET on patient fees (Tax Facts 98-1).

findings.claim: Hawaii economic nexus (Act 41, 2018) requires GET registration at $100,000 of Hawaii-delivered gross income OR 200 separate transactions in the current or preceding calendar year
findings.detail: DOTAX Announcement 2018-10 (amended): a taxpayer without physical presence must license, file and remit GET if 'gross income or gross proceeds of $100,000 or more' from tangible property delivered in Hawaii etc., or '200 or more separate transactions'. 'You will be subject to GET if you meet the $100,000 or the 200-transaction threshold; you do not need to meet both.' Effective July 1, 2018. For a lab, 200 cases/year (~17/month) into Hawaii is the binding trigger; the resulting tax is 0.5% wholesale.

findings.claim: Hawaii foreign LLC registration costs $50 (+$25 expedited, +$1 State Archives fee); LLC annual report $15
findings.detail: DCCA BREG fee schedule (page dated 2026-01-22): Application for Certificate of Authority $50.00 / expedited $25.00; Annual Report $15.00 / $25.00; Good Standing Certificate $5.00. FLLC-1 form (2026/01 upload) shows 'Nonrefundable Filing Fee: $50.00'; a certificate of good standing from the home state dated within 60 days may be required. Registration is required only for entities 'conducting business in Hawaii' (physical presence); interstate mail-order sales alone generally do not require it (reading of HRS 428-1003, not verified this session).

findings.claim: Hawaii does not license dental laboratories or dental technicians
findings.detail: HRS 448-3(a): '...nothing in this chapter shall prohibit any unlicensed person from performing merely mechanical work upon inert matter in a dental laboratory.' HRS 448-1 exempts from the practice of dentistry the 'making of artificial... appliances, or materials... upon orders, prescription, casts, models... furnished by a Hawaii licensed dentist'. DCCA Board of Dentistry licenses only dentists and dental hygienists (DT/DH license types). No lab registration program exists at DCCA PVL.

findings.claim: Hawaii dental laboratory technician wages: 120 employed statewide, median $45,300, mean $47,560 (May 2025); no Kahului-Wailuku MSA estimate published
findings.detail: BLS OEWS May 2025 compiled by WageDex: Hawaii median $45,300, mean $47,560, employment 120 (9% below national median $49,610); Urban Honolulu median $45,300, employment 110. May 2024 (PayScaleIndex from BLS): Hawaii employment 130, mean $44,500, median $41,600, 10th pct $35,890, 25th $36,210, 75th $46,800, 90th $66,040. BLS county-link page confirms Maui County maps to the Kahului-Wailuku MSA, but the bls.gov area tables did not render and no 51-9081 Maui row was found in compilations (likely suppressed for small employment). Context: Maui MSA all-occupation median $27.71/hr; Maui dental assistants 200 employed, median $45,300; dental hygienists 90, $100,230.

findings.claim: Small Maui office/flex space currently lists at $1.35-$4.00/SF/month NNN plus CAM and GET pass-through
findings.detail: 375 Huku Lii Pl (Kihei Gateway Center) Units 203/204, 691 SF each, $1.35 and $1.65/SF/mo NNN, sublease through 12/31/2027 (updated Sep 19, 2026); 169 Maa St Kahului (Maui Lani) 756 SF, $2.50/SF/mo NNN + OPEX $0.94/SF/mo; 444 Hana Hwy Unit C (Dairy Center) Kahului 404 SF, $2,005.10/mo full service; 137 Maa St Kahului 748-993 SF new, $3.50/SF + CAM $0.48 (available Jan 1, 2027); 284 Kehalani Village Dr #5 Wailuku 1,249-1,379 SF, $3.50-$4.00/SF/mo NNN (updated Sep 16, 2026); 313 N Market St Unit 2 Wailuku 580 SF, $1,500/mo; 63 Laa St 61A Kahului warehouse/office $2.10/SF/mo; 330 Ohukai Rd Kihei 1,400 SF M-1 flex for sale $570,000. GET pass-through evidenced by Maui listings ('plus GET @ 4.712%') and a DLNR-filed Hawaii sublease showing a 4.712% GET line.

findings.claim: SEA-OGG nonstop service is daily (Alaska 26/wk, Delta 7/wk); typical round-trip $365-780, cheapest nonstop $457; January cheapest, June most expensive
findings.detail: Google Flights (accessed 2026-10-12): 'Typical price: $365-780'; 'Cheapest nonstop flights $457 Alaska Dec 3-9'; 'January Cheapest: $235-550; June Most expensive: $475-680'; fastest 5h54m; 26 Alaska and 7 Delta nonstops weekly. Expedia (bookings Jan 2025-Apr 2026): average one-way fare by month from $262 (Jan) to $425 (Dec). HVCB/Meet Hawaii quarterly average round-trip base airfare Seattle to Hawaii: Q2 2025 $602, Q3 2025 $616, Q4 2025 $667, Q1 2026 $697 (updated July 15, 2026). Alaska acquired Hawaiian Airlines in 2024 (not re-sourced here).

findings.claim: Maui rental cars: midsize about $82/day shoulder season; weekly lowest OGG rates $312 (Aug 2026) to $635 (June 2026) for midsize
findings.detail: mauicarrental.biz weekly survey of lowest one-week OGG rates across 10+ companies: Aug 2026 economy $258, midsize $312, SUV $385 (Aug 2025: $228/$288/$296); June 2026 economy $450, midsize $635, SUV $881, 'roughly double' June 2025. Hawaii-Guide sampled midsize base rate $82/day (Maui), 7-day rental booked 30 days out, shoulder season.

findings.claim: Maui lodging: hotel ADR $526 and vacation-rental ADR $649 in Aug 2026; Wailea/Kihei rentals about $438-453/night
findings.detail: HTA/DBEDT Hawaii Vacation Rental Performance Report, August 2026: Maui County VR ADR $648.94, occupancy 44.0%; 'Maui County hotels reported ADR at $526 and occupancy of 62.4 percent'; Wailea/Kihei VR ADR $438.48. June 2026 report: Kahului/Wailuku VR ADR $453.04 (YTD). July 2026 hotel report: Maui County ADR $578.63, occupancy 73.7%.

findings.claim: The Aug 2023 Lahaina fire destroyed at least three dental offices; Lahaina Smiles reopened at Lahaina Gateway after 2+ years with its own milling center, Lahaina Dental Group relocated, Dodson Brothers' Lahaina office is still closed
findings.detail: Lahaina Smiles (Drs. Glenn Kadohiro, since 1985, and Steve Barba): 'our team lost not only our office... After more than two years of rebuilding... reopen our doors at Lahaina Gateway... a 3D printing lab, a crown milling center, and an updated CBCT'. Lahaina Dental Group: 'we lost our office in the recent devastating events', now 845 Wainee St Ste 206. Dodson Brothers: 'Our Lahaina location was deeply affected by the fire... continue caring for you at our Kihei location.'

findings.claim: Maui County carries 7 dental HPSA designations with an 11-FTE federal dental gap, concentrated in Medicaid/geographic populations, not private restorative demand
findings.detail: HRSA Data Warehouse via plainhealthaccess: dental HPSAs for Community Clinic of Maui (score 26), Molokai Ohana Health Care, Maui County ME (score 16, pop 14,320), Lanai Community Health Center, Hana Health, Molokai General, Maui Community Correctional Center; 'providers_needed' dental 11 FTE. Maui County population 164,754.

findings.claim: Obtainable Maui demand for a Bellevue lab: base case 2-4 practices and 15-40 units/month within 12 months; upside 6-8 practices and 50-80 units/month with on-island selling
findings.detail: Derivation: ~64 practices; ~7 self-milling; two OMS All-on-4 centers (Maui Jaw Surgical Institute, Maui Oral Surgery) generate full-arch finals restored by GPs; competitors offer free USPS inbound (Glidewell), 3-5 day in-lab, and sub-$50 zirconia (Next). Integra's $129 zirconia is not price-competitive; its differentiators are relationship, digital-only Rx (no inbound shipping), full-arch/ti-bar depth, and ARUM/MillBox service to in-house millers. Assumes a GP sends 5-15 units/month to a secondary lab. No evidence of dentist dissatisfaction with current labs was found.

unknowns: Whether Elua II Dental Laboratory (Kihei) and Pacific Rim Dental Laboratory (Wailuku) are actively operating in 2025-2026: no dated activity found; Hawaii DCCA business registry (hbe.ehawaii.gov) is a dynamic site not queryable with the tools available and was not checked.
Precision Dental Technik LLC closure: inferred from the owner's LinkedIn (ownership ended Jan 2012) and the suite now being Kahului Dental; not confirmed against DCCA records.
FDA establishment registrations for Maui/Hawaii dental labs were not checked (FDA FURLS database not reachable via the tools used); most small labs are exempt from registration in any case.
Which specific labs Maui dentists use today: no Maui practice website names its outside laboratory; Glidewell/Oahu usage is inferred from marketing, not observed.
How Oahu labs ship to Maui (inter-island air cargo vs USPS/FedEx) and their neighbor-island turnaround: not described on any lab page found.
Dandy's and NDX/National Dentex's Hawaii-specific shipping/turnaround policies: not found; Dandy implies guaranteed turnaround is limited to a 'delivery area'.

FedEx transit times and rates Bellevue to Kahului: fedex.com blocks crawlers; not sourced. Estimate (unsourced): FedEx 2Day/Priority Overnight to Hawaii typically 2 business days, roughly $35-60 for a 1-lb case box.
Alaska Air Cargo SEA-OGG tariff and cutoff times for a Known Shipper: not researched this session.
